title: THREATS IN THE ALERT LANE, IN HIS VOICE
why: His order of 2026-10-09: every line the player reads in a raid reads like Call of Duty, Fortnite or ARC Raiders. The threat lines were sentences in the message rows (Something woke up. It was playing dead. The survivor returns fire.) and could be pushed down by the next remark. They are now short caps callouts in the alert slot: SOMETHING WOKE UP, IT WAS PLAYING DEAD, THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU, SOMETHING HUGE HAS NOTICED YOU, MORE PILLAGERS HAVE COME UP, YOUR RIVAL IS UP TOP with his name and that he shoots on sight under it, PILLAGER TURNED HOSTILE with the name under it, GRENADE HIT COVER with Get clear of the blast under it, THE SURVIVOR RETURNS FIRE, and GRENADE WENT OFF IN YOUR HAND as a critical alert (THE SURVIVOR RETURNS FIRE took the same words in v22.07).
now: Threat lines are short caps callouts in the alert slot, such as THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU and PILLAGER TURNED HOSTILE.

edits.anchor: sayWhenFree('YOUR RIVAL is out here: '+nm+'. He will shoot on sight.','warn');
edits.replacement: sayWhenFree('YOUR RIVAL IS UP TOP','warn',{sub:nm+' shoots on sight.'});
if(tk==='frag') say('GRENADE HIT COVER','warn',{sub:'Get clear of the blast.'});

edits.anchor: say('It went off in your hand.');
edits.replacement: say('GRENADE WENT OFF IN YOUR HAND','crit');   // v16.xx, the raid text rewrite (R09): a threat is an alert headline in the shooter voice (his order of 2026-10-09)

edits.anchor: say('More pillagers have entered the area.');
else say('THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU.');
edits.replacement: else say('THE PILLBOX HAS SEEN YOU','warn');

edits.anchor: else say('Something very large has noticed you.');
edits.replacement: else say('SOMETHING HUGE HAS NOTICED YOU','warn');

edits.anchor: if(mine&&!G.sim) say('Something very large has noticed you.');
edits.replacement: if(mine&&!G.sim) say('SOMETHING HUGE HAS NOTICED YOU','warn');

edits.anchor: if(!G.sim) say(e.name+' does not like that.');
edits.replacement: if(!G.sim) say('PILLAGER TURNED HOSTILE','warn',{sub:e.name+' does not like that.'});   // v16.xx, the raid text rewrite (R09): a threat is an alert headline in the shooter voice (his order of 2026-10-09)
